decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw while using Niv-Mizzet, Parun and Thing in the Ice as win conditions. Narset, Parter of Veils limits the opponent's card draw, and Day's Undoing can reset the game while refilling your hand. The deck also utilizes powerful spells like Treasure Cruise and Expressive Iteration to maintain card advantage. The lands are carefully chosen to provide the right colors of mana and allow for flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through careful resource management.

Utilize spells and instants to quickly fill your graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, while also controlling the board with removal spells and card draw. Use aggressive creatures like Stormwing Entity and Thing in the Ice to apply pressure, while also keeping your opponent on their toes with counter spells like Negate. Utilize the flexibility of cards like Expressive Iteration and Izzet Charm to adapt to different situations. Finish off your opponent with a swarm of Arclight Phoenixes or a big swing from Stormwing Entity. Be efficient with your resources and constantly be thinking ahead to outpace and outmaneuver your opponent.

The main focus of this Izzet Control deck is to efficiently control the board using a combination of removal spells and counter spells while generating card advantage through effects like Treasure Cruise and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to clear the board with cards like Anger of the Gods and Flame-Blessed Bolt, and then quickly refill their hand using draw spells. Additionally, the deck looks to close out the game with finishers like Niv-Mizzet, Parun and Thing in the Ice while protecting their threats with Brazen Borrower. Ultimately, the goal is to out-value and outlast the opponent.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up with mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while generating value with cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Voice of Resurgence. Winota, Joiner of Forces is the centerpiece of the deck, allowing you to cheat out powerful creatures like Brutal Cathar and Tovolar's Huntmaster. Esika's Chariot and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional ways to generate tokens and trigger Winota's ability. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multiple colors and ensure consistent mana sources for your spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful planeswalkers and spells while using Fires of Invention to cast multiple spells each turn without paying their mana costs. By denying opponents resources with Narset and board wipes like Anger of the Gods and Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to stall the game until it can win with powerful finishers like Chandra, Awakened Inferno or Shark Typhoon. The deck's versatile sideboard options with Fae of Wishes allow for adapting to various matchups and providing answers to different threats.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly build a board of evasive and disruptive spirit creatures, utilizing cards like Ascendant Spirit and Shacklegeist to pressure the opponent. The deck aims to maintain tempo by leveraging its creatures' abilities to protect themselves and pressure the opponent while also utilizing cards like Curious Obsession to draw cards and maintain card advantage. The inclusion of counterspells and Brazen Borrower helps the deck deal with threats and maintain control of the game, while also having the potential to snowball with cards like Supreme Phantom and Spectral Adversary.

This deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing a combination of efficient removal spells, disruptive hand disruption, and powerful creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It aims to apply pressure early on and maintain control of the board through a mix of direct damage and creature-based threats. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Sorin the Mirthless and Chandra, Torch of Defiance provides additional value and versatility in closing out the game. Overall, the deck is built to be fast-paced and proactive in securing victory before the opponent can stabilize.

This Izzet Control deck is heavily focused on card advantage and disruption, utilizing a combination of cheap removal spells like Flame-Blessed Bolt and Fiery Impulse, along with powerful planeswalkers like Chandra, Awakened Inferno and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to control the game with counter spells and board wipes like Anger of the Gods, while also utilizing card draw spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise to maintain hand advantage. The win condition of the deck revolves around flipping Thing in the Ice and using Hullbreaker Horror for additional control and tempo advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on maintaining a powerful aggressive presence on the battlefield. It utilizes a variety of disruptive and removal spells like Dreadbore, Kolaghan's Command, and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board and clear the way for its own creatures. The deck also includes disruption and hand control with cards like Thoughtseize and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. There are several strong creatures in the deck, including Bonecrusher Giant, Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, and Bloodtithe Harvester, which can deal significant damage and help secure victory. The deck also features a small land package to support its aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Winota, Joiner of Forces to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield, creating a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck is built around creating a fast and efficient Winota trigger while also utilizing other powerful creatures like Brutal Cathar and Voice of Resurgence to pressure the opponent. The key strategy is to ramp up with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to cast Winota early and often, ensuring a steady stream of threats to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is utilizing Winota, Joiner of Forces to create a powerful army of creatures by constantly triggering her ability with the numerous human creatures in the deck. By getting multiple triggers of Winota, you can overwhelm your opponent with a fast and aggressive attacking force. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Voice of Resurgence and Tovolar's Huntmaster to further support the strategy of flooding the board with creatures and maximizing the potential of Winota's ability.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early in the game with efficient threats and disruption spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand using cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also removing key creatures with removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Angrath, the Flame-Chained to provide additional value and close out games quickly. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, overwhelming opponents before they can fully develop their game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils, along with counterspells like Dovin's Veto and Absorb. The main win condition is The Wandering Emperor and Shark Typhoon, with additional removal and card draw spells like Supreme Verdict and Memory Deluge. The deck also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value. With a mix of control elements, card advantage, and a diverse land base, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a slower, grindy game.

The concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a focus on flying creatures and tempo plays. By using efficient creatures like Empyrean Eagle and Watcher of the Spheres to boost the power of flying spirits, combined with disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Lofty Denial, it aims to control the game and close it out quickly. With a mix of aggression and control elements, this Azorius Tempo / Spirit Aggro deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while protecting its own creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, allowing for an early Winota, Joiner of Forces to be played. Once Winota is out, the goal is to use her ability to put strong human creatures like Brutal Cathar and Tovolar's Huntmaster onto the battlefield for a powerful attack. Cards like Voice of Resurgence and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Esika's Chariot provides additional creatures for Winota triggers. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can also be used as a finisher to overwhelm the opponent.

The main goal of this Red Deck Wins aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, along with burn spells like Skewer the Critics and Play with Fire, the deck aims to deal consistent damage and pressure the opponent early on. Cards like Chandra, Dressed to Kill and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide additional value and removal options, while lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins help maintain aggression. The deck's strategy revolves around fast, efficient damage output to secure victory.
